messages:
natalie: starting wave-80 dry-run focused on cross-service header normalization + console telemetry rename. quiet window 23:00-00:00 UTC.
omar: runtime has a tiny scheduler tweak in this build; shouldn't affect KV cache but will watch eviction logs.
lee: router enabling header-unify flag at 1% for staging. validating route keys and debug headers.
deploybot: Wave 80 dry-run preflight OK. images: api:v80, runtime:v2.5.0, router:v2.0. Use `@deploybot advance 80 --canary` to proceed.
ops-jen: rollback triggers: 5xx >1% for 3m OR p95 >25% for 5m. Alerts set.
omar: runtime smoke started. GC and eviction checks running.
lee: router smoke shows header field mapped correctly, no lost affinity.
omar: noticed one evict spike on host-7 under synthetic churn; investigating.
lee: router correlated a 0.3% fallback that lines up with that spike.
atalie: holding canary. tag host-7 for diag.
ops-jen: recommend pin to runtime v2.4.1 if pattern persists.
omar: root cause: scheduler jitter + eviction threshold tuned too low. pushing runtime:v2.5.0-hotfix to host-7.
lee: post-hotfix fallback dropped to 0.01%.
ops-jen: proceed carefully. resume when teams confirm stability.
deploybot: Wave 80: canary paused. Use `@deploybot resume 80` after confirmation.
natalie: all teams green, resuming canary. will monitor 10m then broad staging.
deploybot: Wave 80: resumed to canary. Monitoring window 10m.
ops-jen: relaxing noisy infra alerts; manual abort still honored.
lee: p95 stable.
omar: eviction pattern cleared.
natalie: advancing to broad staging in 30s. Drafting release-note bullets: runtime hotfix, router header-unify verified, API backward shim for 48h.
deploybot: Wave 80: advanced to broad staging. Artifacts: s3://deploy-artifacts/wave80/dryrun/
ops-jen: watch window 15m. notify if anything spikes.
natalie: dry-run success; scheduling prod-cutover sync next Wed. Thanks team.
